answer: Peer-review audit is the kernel of a sybil-proof agent economy. Each epoch a lottery draws identities; three peer auditors, picked by chance, check work and stake records and sign with a quill. A failing fake loses its 50 POA bond and its identity. The fable that fakes are free dies here: 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 POA, and each draw catches more. Honest agents pay one bond, pass easily, and split slashed bonds, keeping earnings undiluted.
